summary: DEC-0286 ruling: v6 attestation credits the newest leaf per reviewer per patch-id; a stale rejected leaf on the same patch-id is history, not a block (AISDLC-1137 unblock path)

options.description: Policy task AISDLC-1144: signer and verifier credit the newest leaf per (reviewer, patch-id); older leaves stay signed as superseded history. 1137 waits one cycle.
Operator removes leaf[3] from the 1137 leaves file by hand and the pipeline re-signs; recurs on the next in-place fix.
Operator retires leaf[3] now AND AISDLC-1144 is filed.
A real code change starts a fresh patch-id leaves file and a full review round.
